comments.text:
Azure is Microsoft's cloud computing platform—like AWS or Google Cloud, but built by Microsoft. It provides 200+ services for computing power, data storage, networking, analytics, AI/ML, and more, all hosted in global data centers so you don't manage your own hardware.

It's different mainly in seamless integration with Microsoft tools (Windows, Office 365, Dynamics), strong hybrid cloud options (mix on-prem + cloud), enterprise-grade security/compliance, and AI focus via services like Azure OpenAI.

Certs like AI-900/AI-102 absolutely boost employability—entry-level Azure AI roles often start $50-80k (varies by location/experience), but mid-level AI engineers hit $110k-$160k avg in the US per 2026 data from Glassdoor/ZipRecruiter. High demand in AI/cloud (35%+ growth projected), but pair certs with projects/portfolio for real traction. Start free on Microsoft Learn!

comments.text:
AI-900 (Fundamentals): Covers AI workloads, ML principles on Azure, computer vision, NLP, and generative AI. You'll learn to identify Azure AI services for common scenarios—no coding, just awareness.

AI-102 (AI Engineer): Plan/manage AI solutions; implement generative AI, agents, computer vision, NLP, knowledge mining. Hands-on building/deploying with Azure AI services (Python/C# focus).

AZ-305 (Solutions Architect): Design identity/governance, data storage, continuity, and infra solutions. Useful for scaling AI apps on Azure.

Demand is strong—AI jobs booming 35%+ by 2030, Azure AI certs lead to $120K+ roles in engineering/architecture per 2026 market data. Start with free Microsoft Learn paths!
